`class HeifResourceFormat`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/iresourceformat/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [HeifResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/impl/HeifResourceFormat.java)

The built-in format that recognizes HEIF and AVIF images, which JOID cannot decode, to fail with a clear message.

## Description

The resource fails, and the dev-mode warning asks for PNG, JPEG or WebP instead.
